messages.en:
I'm moving, and I hope
that you're a little more
stylish the next time we
meet. Sound like a plan?
messages.et:
Ma kolin ja loodan,
et sa oled järgmine kord,
kui kohtume, veidi stiilsem.
Kõlab plaanina?

messages.en:
I'm moving! And I'm kinda
sad. {0b 03 00}{04 11 00} was good
to me...although YOU were
a real handful!
messages.et:
Ma kolin! Ja mul on
natuke kurb. {0b 03 00}{04 11 00} oli
minuga hea...kuigi SINA olid
üks tõeline käputäis!

messages.en:
I'm leaving {04 11 00},
but I'm not sad! It'll be
exciting to meet some
new, cultured people!
messages.et:
Ma lahkun linnast nimega
{04 11 00}, mul pole kurb!
On põnev kohtuda uute,
kultuursete inimestega!

messages.en:
I'm moving, and it's sad.
But the IMPORTANT thing is
it's all about me. 'Cause
I'm moving. And it's sad.
messages.et:
Ma kolin ja see on kurb.
Aga TÄHTIS on see, et
asi on minus. Sest mina
kolin. Ja see on kurb.

messages.en:
I'm leaving town! I wanted
it to be a big mystery,
but I'm actually just
bored. See ya.
messages.et:
Ma lahkun linnast! Tahtsin,
et see oleks mõistatus,
aga tegelikult on mul
lihtsalt igav. Näeme.
